note: NECO Christian Religious Studies Paper III round 1: the SSCE syllabus - creation and the fall, the patriarchs (Abraham to Joseph), Moses and the exodus, Joshua and the judges, the kings of Israel, the prophets, the life and ministry of Jesus, the passion and resurrection, the early church, and the great themes (faith, justice, forgiveness, service, love). Near-dup scanned against the JAMB, WAEC and existing NECO banks.
